🚀 Big Launches.title: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plug-in
🚀 Big Launches.summary: OpenAI released a plug‑in for Apple Messages that lets ChatGPT draft and send texts on your behalf, turning the chat model into a personal texting assistant.

🚀 Big Launches.title: Google gives publishers a new way to fight AI‑driven traffic losses
🚀 Big Launches.summary: Google added a ‘preferred source’ button that lets publishers signal to Search, Discover and News that their content should be prioritized, aiming to recover traffic lost to AI‑generated content.

🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.title: Up to 3.2x Faster Inference with LFM2.5-DSpark
🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.summary: Hugging Face announced LFM2.5‑DSpark, an open‑source inference engine that accelerates large‑language‑model serving by up to 3.2× on commodity hardware.

🎯 Interview Edge.title: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plug-in
🎯 Interview Edge.summary: The new plug‑in showcases Agentic AI, where a model performs actions (sending texts) autonomously—a hot topic for interview questions on prompting and tool use.

🎯 Interview Edge.title: Up to 3.2x Faster Inference with LFM2.5-DSpark
🎯 Interview Edge.summary: Speed‑up techniques like DSpark are becoming interview fodder for MLOps roles, highlighting quantization, batching, and hardware‑aware serving strategies.

⚖️ Responsible AI.title: Introducing AI Futures
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: OpenAI’s new blog series explores how transformative AI could reshape power structures, governance, economies, and individual freedoms, underscoring the need for ethical frameworks.

tool_of_day.title: LFM2.5‑DSpark Inference Engine
tool_of_day.summary: An open‑source engine that boosts LLM inference speed up to 3.2×, ideal for students building low‑latency AI services.

hot_take: The industry is shifting from headline‑grabbing model releases to real‑world integrations and performance engineering, so fresh grads should double‑down on MLOps, agentic AI, and deployment efficiency.
